scope: Reference-guided R4 design proposals, not native captures

records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / reference-guided style transfer.
Asset type: high-fidelity bridge design for an EXISTING Godot game UI; FOB / Loadout, landscape 16:9.
Input images: Image1 FINAL USER-APPROVED 2D DESIGN is the visual authority; Image2 CURRENT NATIVE R3 is the functional content/state authority; Image3 ACTUAL NEW MAIN FRONTIER OUTPOST is the environmental/material reference.
Primary request: The user rejects R3 as much too far from Image1. Show a concrete faithful style translation, not another generic dark dashboard. Preserve all useful real controls/data from Image2 while visibly adopting Image1's rich deep petrol instruments, cyan blue fine double-edge frames, bright cream bold/condensed section headings, yellow selection/primary action, portrait-led cards and coherent modular hierarchy. UI panels remain DARK PETROL. Cream/offwhite belongs to illustrated buildings/ships, never washed-out gray UI chips. No giant buttons or excessive blank framed space.
Layout: Personnel pool left, real fireteam and loadout cards in center, transport controls right. Put a visible atmospheric outpost/flightdeck scene in the available right-lower area, instead of a vast flat empty box. Keep empty/waiting statuses honest.
Use actual existing portrait identity/content where possible; illustrative figures do not redefine character data. Body copy remains readable, native-text-like, concise German. Primary controls compact; no inventing gameplay actions, readiness, loading weights, campaign progress, successful returns or times. Keep R3 honest missing fields.
Scene/background: integrate the supplied real Frontier visual vocabulary and cream modular buildings rather than unrelated old pixel-art sky. Illustration is visually subordinate to crisp readable native foreground.
Constraints: do not bake a fake implementation claim. This is a proposal to guide native code. Preserve compactness and all stated action ordering. No game title in the mission's upper left. Show complete screen with no cropped actions.
Include a narrow unobtrusive designer footer outside the UI containing 3 short German rationale labels for observable choices: 'Petrol bündelt', 'Portrait schafft Identität', 'Kontur trennt Zustände'. These are explicit design explanations, not hidden reasoning.
